<h1 id="gitea-api">Gitea API v0.0.0+GITEA-API-APP-VERSION</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

This documentation describes the Gitea API.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1</a>

License: <a href="http://opensource.org/licenses/MIT">MIT</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (AccessToken)
    - Parameter Name: **access_token**, in: query. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

* API Key (AuthorizationHeaderToken)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: basic

* API Key (SudoHeader)
    - Parameter Name: **Sudo**, in: header. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

* API Key (SudoParam)
    - Parameter Name: **sudo**, in: query. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

* API Key (TOTPHeader)
    - Parameter Name: **X-GITEA-OTP**, in: header. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

* API Key (Token)
    - Parameter Name: **token**, in: query. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

<h1 id="gitea-api-admin">admin</h1>

Site administration

## Lists all jobs

<a id="opIdlistAdminWorkflowJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/actions/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /admin/actions/jobs`

<h3 id="lists-all-jobs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|false|workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|
|sort|query|string|false|sort jobs by attribute. Supported values are "id". Default is "id"|
|order|query|string|false|sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc"|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "completed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "conclusion": "string",
      "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "head_branch": "string",
      "head_sha": "string",
      "html_url": "http://example.com",
      "id": 0,
      "labels": [
        "string"
      ],
      "name": "string",
      "run_attempt": 0,
      "run_id": 0,
      "run_url": "http://example.com",
      "runner_id": 0,
      "runner_name": "string",
      "started_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "status": "string",
      "steps": [
        {
          "completed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
          "conclusion": "string",
          "name": "string",
          "number": 0,
          "started_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
          "status": "string"
        }
      ],
      "url": "http://example.com"
    }
  ],
  "total_count": 0
}
```

<h3 id="lists-all-jobs-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|WorkflowJobsList|[ActionWorkflowJobsResponse](#schemaactionworkflowjobsresponse)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Get all runners

<a id="opIdgetAdminRunners"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/actions/runners \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /admin/actions/runners`

<h3 id="get-all-runners-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|disabled|query|boolean|false|filter by disabled status (true or false)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "runners": [
    {
      "busy": true,
      "disabled": true,
      "ephemeral": true,
      "id": 0,
      "labels": [
        {
          "id": 0,
          "name": "string",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "name": "string",
      "status": "string"
    }
  ],
  "total_count": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-runners-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|RunnerList|[ActionRunnersResponse](#schemaactionrunnersresponse)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

<a id="opIddeleteAdminRunner"></a>

|default|message|string||none|

## Update a global runner

<a id="opIdupdateAdminRunner"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/actions/runners/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "disabled": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /admin/actions/runners/{runner_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "disabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-global-runner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|runner_id|path|string|true|id of the runner|
|body|body|[EditActionRunnerOption](#schemaeditactionrunneroption)|false|none|
|» disabled|body|boolean|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "busy": true,
  "disabled": true,
  "ephemeral": true,
  "id": 0,
  "labels": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "name": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "status": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-global-runner-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Runner|[ActionRunner](#schemaactionrunner)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Lists all runs

<a id="opIdlistAdminWorkflowRuns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/actions/runs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /admin/actions/runs`

<h3 id="lists-all-runs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|event|query|string|false|workflow event name|
|branch|query|string|false|workflow branch|
|status|query|string|false|workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)|
|actor|query|string|false|triggered by user|
|head_sha|query|string|false|triggering sha of the workflow run|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

## Create a hook

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/hooks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "events": [
      "string"
    ],
    "name": "string",
    "type": "dingtalk"
  }'
```

`POST /admin/hooks`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "authorization_header": "string",
  "branch_filter": "string",
  "config": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "events": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "type": "dingtalk"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|» authorization_header|body|string|false|Authorization header to include in webhook requests|
|» branch_filter|body|string|false|Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook|
|» config|body|[CreateHookOptionConfig](#schemacreatehookoptionconfig)|true|CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it<br>required are "content_type" and "url" Required|
|» events|body|[string]|false|List of events that will trigger this webhook|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional human-readable name for the webhook|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of the webhook to create|

## Search users according filter conditions

<a id="opIdadminSearchUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /admin/users`

<h3 id="search-users-according-filter-conditions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|source_id|query|integer(int64)|false|ID of the user's login source to search for, 0 means the local users|
|login_name|query|string|false|identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|
|sort|query|string|false|sort users by attribute. Supported values are "name", "created", "updated" and "id". Default is "name"|
|order|query|string|false|sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified.|
|q|query|string|false|search term (username, full name, email)|
|visibility|query|string|false|visibility filter. Supported values are "public", "limited" and "private".|
|is_active|query|boolean|false|filter active users|
|is_admin|query|boolean|false|filter admin users|
|is_restricted|query|boolean|false|filter restricted users|
|is_2fa_enabled|query|boolean|false|filter 2FA enabled users|
|is_prohibit_login|query|boolean|false|filter login prohibited users|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "active": true,
    "avatar_url": "http://example.com",
    "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "description": "string",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "followers_count": 0,
    "following_count": 0,
    "full_name": "string",
    "html_url": "http://example.com",
    "id": 0,
    "is_admin": true,
    "language": "string",
    "last_login": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "location": "string",
    "login": "string",
    "login_name": "string",
    "prohibit_login": true,
    "restricted": true,
    "source_id": 0,
    "starred_repos_count": 0,
    "type": {},
    "visibility": {},
    "website": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="search-users-according-filter-conditions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|UserList|Inline|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

<h3 id="search-users-according-filter-conditions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Create a user

<a id="opIdadminCreateUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "email": "string",
    "full_name": "string",
    "login_name": "string",
    "must_change_password": true,
    "password": "string",
    "restricted": true,
    "send_notify": true,
    "source_id": 0,
    "username": "string",
    "visibility": {}
  }'
```

`POST /admin/users`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "email": "string",
  "full_name": "string",
  "login_name": "string",
  "must_change_password": true,
  "password": "string",
  "restricted": true,
  "send_notify": true,
  "source_id": 0,
  "username": "string",
  "visibility": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateUserOption](#schemacreateuseroption)|false|none|
|» created_at|body|string(date-time)|false|For explicitly setting the user creation timestamp. Useful when users are<br>migrated from other systems. When omitted, the user's creation timestamp<br>will be set to "now".|
|» email|body|string|true|none|
|» full_name|body|string|false|The full display name of the user|
|» login_name|body|string|false|identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator (if configured)|
|» must_change_password|body|boolean|false|Whether the user must change password on first login|
|» password|body|string|false|The plain text password for the user|
|» restricted|body|boolean|false|Whether the user has restricted access privileges|
|» send_notify|body|boolean|false|Whether to send welcome notification email to the user|
|» source_id|body|integer(int64)|false|The authentication source ID to associate with the user|
|» username|body|string|true|username of the user|
|» visibility|body|object|false|User visibility level: public, limited, or private|

```json
  "login": "string",

  "restricted": true,

  "type": {},
  "visibility": {},

}
```

<a id="opIdadminCreateRepo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/admin/users/string/repos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_init": true,
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gitignores": "string",
    "issue_labels": "string",
    "license": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "object_format_name": {},
    "private": true,
    "readme": "string",
    "template": true,
    "trust_model": "default"
  }'
```

`POST /admin/users/{username}/repos`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_init": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gitignores": "string",
  "issue_labels": "string",
  "license": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "object_format_name": {},
  "private": true,
  "readme": "string",
  "template": true,
  "trust_model": "default"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-repository-on-behalf-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|body|body|[CreateRepoOption](#schemacreaterepooption)|true|none|
|» auto_init|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository should be auto-initialized?|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|DefaultBranch of the repository (used when initializes and in template)|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the repository to create|

<h1 id="gitea-api-issue">issue</h1>

Issues, pull requests, comments, labels and milestones

## Search for issues across the repositories that the user has access to

<a id="opIdissueSearchIssues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/issues/search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/issues/search`

<h3 id="search-for-issues-across-the-repositories-that-the-user-has-access-to-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state|query|string|false|State of the issue|
|labels|query|string|false|Comma-separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of these labels. Non existent labels are discarded.|
|milestones|query|string|false|Comma-separated list of milestone names. Fetch only issues that have any of these milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded.|
|q|query|string|false|Search string|
|type|query|string|false|Filter by issue type|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show issues updated after the given time (RFC 3339 format)|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show issues updated before the given time (RFC 3339 format)|
|assigned|query|boolean|false|Filter issues or pulls assigned to the authenticated user|
|created|query|boolean|false|Filter issues or pulls created by the authenticated user|
|mentioned|query|boolean|false|Filter issues or pulls mentioning the authenticated user|
|review_requested|query|boolean|false|Filter pull requests where the authenticated user's review was requested|
|reviewed|query|boolean|false|Filter pull requests reviewed by the authenticated user|
|owner|query|string|false|Filter by repository owner|
|created_by|query|string|false|Only show items which were created by the given user|
|team|query|string|false|Filter by team (requires organization owner parameter)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|Number of items per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|open|
|state|closed|
|state|all|
|type|issues|
|type|pulls|

## List a repository's issues

<a id="opIdissueListIssues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`

<h3 id="list-a-repositorys-issues-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|state|query|string|false|whether issue is open or closed|
|labels|query|string|false|comma separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of this label names. Non existent labels are discarded.|
|q|query|string|false|search string|
|type|query|string|false|filter by type (issues / pulls) if set|
|milestones|query|string|false|comma separated list of milestone names or ids. It uses names and fall back to ids. Fetch only issues that have any of this milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show items updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show items updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|created_by|query|string|false|Only show items which were created by the given user|
|assigned_by|query|string|false|Only show items for which the given user is assigned|
|mentioned_by|query|string|false|Only show items in which the given user was mentioned|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|closed|
|state|open|
|state|all|
|type|issues|
|type|pulls|

## Create an issue. If using deadline only the date will be taken into account, and time of day ignored.

<a id="opIdissueCreateIssue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "assignee": "string",
    "assignees": [
      "string"
    ],
    "body": "string",
    "closed": true,
    "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "labels": [
      0
    ],
    "milestone": 0,
    "projects": [
      0
    ],
    "ref": "string",
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assignee": "string",
  "assignees": [
    "string"
  ],
  "body": "string",
  "closed": true,
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "labels": [
    0
  ],
  "milestone": 0,
  "projects": [
    0
  ],
  "ref": "string",
  "title": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|body|body|[CreateIssueOption](#schemacreateissueoption)|false|none|
|» assignee|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** deprecated|
|» assignees|body|[string]|false|none|
|» body|body|string|false|none|
|» closed|body|boolean|false|none|

|» labels|body|[integer(int64)]|false|list of label ids|
|» milestone|body|integer(int64)|false|milestone id|
|» projects|body|[integer(int64)]|false|list of project ids|
|» ref|body|string|false|none|
|» title|body|string|true|none|

## List all comments in a repository

<a id="opIdissueGetRepoComments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues/comments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments`

<h3 id="list-all-comments-in-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|if provided, only comments updated since the provided time are returned.|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|if provided, only comments updated before the provided time are returned.|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

## Edit an issue. If using deadline only the date will be taken into account, and time of day ignored.

<a id="opIdissueEditIssue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues/0 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "assignee": "string",
    "assignees": [
      "string"
    ],
    "body": "string",
    "content_version": 0,
    "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "milestone": 0,
    "projects": [
      0
    ],
    "ref": "string",
    "state": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "unset_due_date": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}`

Pass `content_version` to enable optimistic locking on body edits.
If the version doesn't match the current value, the request fails with 409 Conflict.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assignee": "string",
  "assignees": [
    "string"
  ],
  "body": "string",
  "content_version": 0,
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "milestone": 0,
  "projects": [
    0
  ],
  "ref": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "unset_due_date": true
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-issue-if-using-deadline-only-the-date-will-be-taken-into-account-and-time-of-day-ignored-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the issue to edit|
|body|body|[EditIssueOption](#schemaeditissueoption)|false|none|
|» assignee|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** deprecated|
|» assignees|body|[string]|false|none|
|» body|body|string|false|none|
|» content_version|body|integer(int64)|false|The current version of the issue content to detect conflicts during editing|
|» due_date|body|string(date-time)|false|Deadline is the updated due date for the issue, use null or empty string to remove the deadline|
|» milestone|body|integer(int64)|false|none|
|» projects|body|[integer(int64)]|false|list of project ids to set (replaces existing projects)|
|» ref|body|string|false|none|
|» state|body|string|false|none|
|» title|body|string|false|none|
|» unset_due_date|body|boolean|false|none|

## Set an issue deadline. If set to null, the deadline is deleted. If using deadline only the date will be taken into account, and time of day ignored.

<a id="opIdissueEditIssueDeadline"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues/0/deadline \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/deadline`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="set-an-issue-deadline-if-set-to-null-the-deadline-is-deleted-if-using-deadline-only-the-date-will-be-taken-into-account-and-time-of-day-ignored-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the issue to create or update a deadline on|
|body|body|[EditDeadlineOption](#schemaeditdeadlineoption)|false|none|
|» due_date|body|string(date-time)|false|Deadline is the updated due date for the issue or pull request, use null or empty string to remove the deadline|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

## List an issue's tracked times

<a id="opIdissueTrackedTimes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues/0/times \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/times`

<h3 id="list-an-issues-tracked-times-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the issue|
|user|query|string|false|optional filter by user (available for issue managers)|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show times updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show times updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

## Add tracked time to a issue

<a id="opIdissueAddTime"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/issues/0/times \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "time": 0,
    "user_name": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/times`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "time": 0,
  "user_name": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-tracked-time-to-a-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the issue|
|body|body|[AddTimeOption](#schemaaddtimeoption)|false|none|
|» created|body|string(date-time)|false|none|
|» time|body|integer(int64)|true|time in seconds|

## Update a milestone

<a id="opIdissueEditMilestone"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/milestones/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "due_on": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "state": {},
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "due_on": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "state": {},
  "title": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-milestone-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|id|path|string|true|the milestone to edit, identified by ID and if not available by name|
|body|body|[EditMilestoneOption](#schemaeditmilestoneoption)|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Description provides updated details about the milestone|
|» due_on|body|string(date-time)|false|Deadline is the due date for the milestone, use null or empty string to remove the deadline|
|» state|body|object|false|State indicates the updated state of the milestone|
|» title|body|string|false|Title is the updated title of the milestone|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "closed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "closed_issues": 0,
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "description": "string",
  "due_on": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "id": 0,
  "open_issues": 0,
  "state": {},
  "title": "string",
  "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-milestone-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Milestone|[Milestone](#schemamilestone)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## List users's notification threads

<a id="opIdnotifyGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /notifications`

<h3 id="list-userss-notification-threads-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|all|query|boolean|false|If true, show notifications marked as read. Default value is false|
|status-types|query|[string]|false|Show notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread & pinned.|
|subject-type|query|[string]|false|filter notifications by subject type|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show notifications updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show notifications updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subject-type|issue|
|subject-type|pull|
|subject-type|commit|
|subject-type|repository|

## Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread

<a id="opIdnotifyReadList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/notifications \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`PUT /notifications`

<h3 id="mark-notification-threads-as-read-pinned-or-unread-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|last_read_at|query|string(date-time)|false|Describes the last point that notifications were checked. Anything updated since this time will not be updated.|
|all|query|string|false|If true, mark all notifications on this repo. Default value is false|
|status-types|query|[string]|false|Mark notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread.|
|to-status|query|string|false|Status to mark notifications as, Defaults to read.|

## List users's notification threads on a specific repo

<a id="opIdnotifyGetRepoList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/notifications`

<h3 id="list-userss-notification-threads-on-a-specific-repo-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|all|query|boolean|false|If true, show notifications marked as read. Default value is false|
|status-types|query|[string]|false|Show notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread & pinned|
|subject-type|query|[string]|false|filter notifications by subject type|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show notifications updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Only show notifications updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subject-type|issue|
|subject-type|pull|
|subject-type|commit|
|subject-type|repository|

## Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread on a specific repo

<a id="opIdnotifyReadRepoList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/notifications \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/notifications`

<h3 id="mark-notification-threads-as-read-pinned-or-unread-on-a-specific-repo-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|all|query|string|false|If true, mark all notifications on this repo. Default value is false|
|status-types|query|[string]|false|Mark notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread.|
|to-status|query|string|false|Status to mark notifications as. Defaults to read.|
|last_read_at|query|string(date-time)|false|Describes the last point that notifications were checked. Anything updated since this time will not be updated.|

## Create a repository in an organization

<a id="opIdcreateOrgRepoDeprecated"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/org/string/repos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_init": true,
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gitignores": "string",
    "issue_labels": "string",
    "license": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "object_format_name": {},
    "private": true,
    "readme": "string",
    "template": true,
    "trust_model": "default"
  }'
```

`POST /org/{org}/repos`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_init": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gitignores": "string",
  "issue_labels": "string",
  "license": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "object_format_name": {},
  "private": true,
  "readme": "string",
  "template": true,
  "trust_model": "default"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-repository-in-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|org|path|string|true|name of organization|
|body|body|[CreateRepoOption](#schemacreaterepooption)|false|none|
|» auto_init|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository should be auto-initialized?|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|DefaultBranch of the repository (used when initializes and in template)|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the repository to create|
|» gitignores|body|string|false|Gitignores to use|
|» issue_labels|body|string|false|Label-Set to use|
|» license|body|string|false|License to use|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the repository to create|
|» object_format_name|body|object|false|ObjectFormatName of the underlying git repository, empty string for default (sha1)|
|» private|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is private|
|» readme|body|string|false|Readme of the repository to create|
|» template|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is template|
|» trust_model|body|string|false|TrustModel of the repository|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» trust_model|default|
|» trust_model|collaborator|
|» trust_model|committer|
|» trust_model|collaboratorcommitter|

```json
  "email": "string",
  "full_name": "string",
```

## Create or Update a secret value in an organization

<a id="opIdupdateOrgSecret"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/orgs/string/actions/secrets/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "data": "string",
    "description": "string"
  }'
```

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "data": "string",
  "description": "string"
```

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/orgs/string/projects/0/columns/move \
```
```bash
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
```

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/orgs/string/repos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_init": true,
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gitignores": "string",
    "issue_labels": "string",
    "license": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "object_format_name": {},
    "private": true,
    "readme": "string",
    "template": true,
    "trust_model": "default"
  }'
```

`POST /orgs/{org}/repos`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_init": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gitignores": "string",
  "issue_labels": "string",
  "license": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "object_format_name": {},
  "private": true,
  "readme": "string",
  "template": true,
  "trust_model": "default"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-repository-in-an-organization-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|org|path|string|true|name of organization|
|body|body|[CreateRepoOption](#schemacreaterepooption)|false|none|
|» auto_init|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository should be auto-initialized?|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|DefaultBranch of the repository (used when initializes and in template)|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the repository to create|
|» gitignores|body|string|false|Gitignores to use|
|» issue_labels|body|string|false|Label-Set to use|
|» license|body|string|false|License to use|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the repository to create|
|» object_format_name|body|object|false|ObjectFormatName of the underlying git repository, empty string for default (sha1)|
|» private|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is private|
|» readme|body|string|false|Readme of the repository to create|

|» can_create_org_repo|body|boolean|false|Whether the team can create repositories in the organization|

|» includes_all_repositories|body|boolean|false|Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» permission|body|object|false|All units have this permission (read/write/admin)|
|» units|body|[string]|false|**Deprecated.** Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions.|
|» units_map|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» visibility|body|object|false|Team visibility within the organization. When omitted, visibility is<br>left unchanged.|

## Remove a repository from a team

<a id="opIdorgRemoveTeamRepository"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/teams/0/repos/string/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /teams/{id}/repos/{org}/{repo}`

This does not delete the repository, it only removes the repository from the team.

<h3 id="remove-a-repository-from-a-team-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the team|
|org|path|string|true|organization that owns the repo to remove|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo to remove|

<h3 id="remove-a-repository-from-a-team-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|

## Delete a package

<a id="opIddeletePackage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/packages/string/string/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}`

<h3 id="delete-a-package-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the package|
|type|path|string|true|type of the package|
|name|path|string|true|name of the package|

<h3 id="delete-a-package-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|APIEmpty is an empty response|None|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

</aside>

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/migrate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "auth_password": "string",
    "auth_token": "string",
    "auth_username": "string",
    "aws_access_key_id": "string",
    "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
    "clone_addr": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "issues": true,
    "labels": true,
    "lfs": true,
    "lfs_endpoint": "string",
    "milestones": true,
    "mirror": true,
    "mirror_interval": "string",
    "private": true,
    "pull_requests": true,
    "releases": true,
    "repo_name": "string",
    "repo_owner": "string",
    "service": "git",
    "uid": 0,
    "wiki": true
  }'
```

```json
{
  "auth_password": "string",
```

## Search for repositories

<a id="opIdrepoSearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/search`

<h3 id="search-for-repositories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|keyword|
|topic|query|boolean|false|Limit search to repositories with keyword as topic|
|includeDesc|query|boolean|false|include search of keyword within repository description|
|uid|query|integer(int64)|false|search only for repos that the user with the given id owns or contributes to|
|priority_owner_id|query|integer(int64)|false|repo owner to prioritize in the results|
|team_id|query|integer(int64)|false|search only for repos that belong to the given team id|
|starredBy|query|integer(int64)|false|search only for repos that the user with the given id has starred|
|private|query|boolean|false|include private repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)|
|is_private|query|boolean|false|show only pubic, private or all repositories (defaults to all)|
|template|query|boolean|false|include template repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)|
|archived|query|boolean|false|show only archived, non-archived or all repositories (defaults to all)|
|mode|query|string|false|type of repository to search for. Supported values are "fork", "source", "mirror" and "collaborative"|
|exclusive|query|boolean|false|if `uid` is given, search only for repos that the user owns|
|sort|query|string|false|sort repos by attribute. Supported values are "alpha", "created", "updated", "size", "git_size", "lfs_size", "stars", "forks" and "id". Default is "alpha"|
|order|query|string|false|sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified.|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

<h3 id="edit-a-repositorys-properties-only-fields-that-are-set-will-be-changed-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo to edit|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo to edit|
|body|body|[EditRepoOption](#schemaeditrepooption)|false|Properties of a repo that you can edit|
|» allow_fast_forward_only_merge|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow fast-forward-only merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent fast-forward-only merging.|
|» allow_manual_merge|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow mark pr as merged manually, or `false` to prevent it.|
|» allow_merge_commits|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow merging pull requests with a merge commit, or `false` to prevent merging pull requests with merge commits.|
|» allow_merge_update|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by merge, or `false` to prevent it.|
|» allow_rebase|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow rebase-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent rebase-merging.|
|» allow_rebase_explicit|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow rebase with explicit merge commits (--no-ff), or `false` to prevent rebase with explicit merge commits.|
|» allow_rebase_update|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by rebase, or `false` to prevent it.|
|» allow_squash_merge|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow squash-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent squash-merging.|
|» archived|body|boolean|false|set to `true` to archive this repository.|
|» autodetect_manual_merge|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable AutodetectManualMerge, or `false` to prevent it. Note: In some special cases, misjudgments can occur.|
|» default_allow_maintainer_edit|body|boolean|false|set to `true` to allow edits from maintainers by default|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|sets the default branch for this repository.|
|» default_delete_branch_after_merge|body|boolean|false|set to `true` to delete pr branch after merge by default|
|» default_merge_style|body|string|false|set to a merge style to be used by this repository: "merge", "rebase", "rebase-merge", "squash", or "fast-forward-only".|
|» default_update_style|body|string|false|set to an update style to be used by this repository: "merge" or "rebase".|
|» description|body|string|false|a short description of the repository.|
|» enable_prune|body|boolean|false|enable prune - remove obsolete remote-tracking references when mirroring|
|» external_tracker|body|[ExternalTracker](#schemaexternaltracker)|false|ExternalTracker represents settings for external tracker|
|» external_wiki|body|[ExternalWiki](#schemaexternalwiki)|false|ExternalWiki represents setting for external wiki|
|» has_actions|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable actions unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|» has_code|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable code for this repository or `false` to disable it.|
|» has_issues|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable issues for this repository or `false` to disable them.|
|» has_packages|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable packages unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|» has_projects|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable project unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|» has_pull_requests|body|boolean|false|either `true` to allow pull requests, or `false` to prevent pull request.|
|» has_releases|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable releases unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|» has_wiki|body|boolean|false|either `true` to enable the wiki for this repository or `false` to disable it.|
|» ignore_whitespace_conflicts|body|boolean|false|either `true` to ignore whitespace for conflicts, or `false` to not ignore whitespace.|
|» internal_tracker|body|[InternalTracker](#schemainternaltracker)|false|InternalTracker represents settings for internal tracker|
|» mirror_interval|body|string|false|set to a string like `8h30m0s` to set the mirror interval time|
|» mirror_password|body|string|false|authentication password for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|» mirror_token|body|string|false|authentication token for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|» mirror_username|body|string|false|authentication username for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|» name|body|string|false|name of the repository|
|» private|body|boolean|false|either `true` to make the repository private or `false` to make it public.<br>Note: you will get a 422 error if the organization restricts changing repository visibility to organization<br>owners and a non-owner tries to change the value of private.|
|» projects_mode|body|string|false|`repo` to only allow repo-level projects, `owner` to only allow owner projects, `all` to allow both.|
|» squash_merge_commit_message|body|string|false|set the default squash merge commit message body: "PR_BODY", "COMMIT_MESSAGES", or "BLANK".|
|» template|body|boolean|false|either `true` to make this repository a template or `false` to make it a normal repository|
|» website|body|string|false|a URL with more information about the repository.|

## Lists all artifacts for a repository

<a id="opIdgetArtifacts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/artifacts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts`

<h3 id="lists-all-artifacts-for-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|name|query|string|false|name of the artifact|

<h3 id="lists-all-artifacts-for-a-repository-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|ArtifactsList|[ActionArtifactsResponse](#schemaactionartifactsresponse)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Gets a specific artifact for a workflow run

<a id="opIdgetArtifact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/artifacts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{artifact_id}`

<h3 id="gets-a-specific-artifact-for-a-workflow-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|artifact_id|path|string|true|id of the artifact|


<h3 id="lists-all-runs-for-a-repository-run-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|WorkflowRunsList|[ActionWorkflowRunsResponse](#schemaactionworkflowrunsresponse)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Gets a specific workflow run

<a id="opIdGetWorkflowRun"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}`

<h3 id="gets-a-specific-workflow-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|id of the run|

## Delete a workflow run

<a id="opIddeleteActionRun"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}`

<h3 id="delete-a-workflow-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|runid of the workflow run|

<h3 id="delete-a-workflow-run-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

<h3 id="lists-all-artifacts-for-a-repository-run-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|ArtifactsList|[ActionArtifactsResponse](#schemaactionartifactsresponse)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Gets a specific workflow run attempt

<a id="opIdgetWorkflowRunAttempt"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0/attempts/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/attempts/{attempt}`

<h3 id="gets-a-specific-workflow-run-attempt-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|id of the run|
|attempt|path|integer|true|logical attempt number of the run|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|WorkflowRun|[ActionWorkflowRun](#schemaactionworkflowrun)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Lists all jobs for a workflow run attempt

<a id="opIdlistWorkflowRunAttemptJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0/attempts/0/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs`

<h3 id="lists-all-jobs-for-a-workflow-run-attempt-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|id of the workflow run|
|attempt|path|integer|true|logical attempt number of the run|
|status|query|string|false|workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "completed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

          "status": "string"
        }
      ],
      "url": "http://example.com"
    }
  ],
  "total_count": 0
}
```

<h3 id="lists-all-jobs-for-a-workflow-run-attempt-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|WorkflowJobsList|[ActionWorkflowJobsResponse](#schemaactionworkflowjobsresponse)|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Cancel a workflow run and its jobs

<a id="opIdcancelWorkflowRun"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/cancel`

<h3 id="cancel-a-workflow-run-and-its-jobs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|run ID|

<h3 id="cancel-a-workflow-run-and-its-jobs-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|WorkflowRun|[ActionWorkflowRun](#schemaactionworkflowrun)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Force-cancel a workflow run

<a id="opIdforceCancelWorkflowRun"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0/force-cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/force-cancel`

Cancels a workflow run without waiting for its runners to acknowledge the cancellation.
The jobs are marked cancelled at once and anything a runner reports for them afterwards is discarded.
Only use this endpoint when the workflow run does not respond to `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/cancel`.


<h3 id="force-cancel-a-workflow-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|run ID|

## Lists all jobs for a workflow run

<a id="opIdlistWorkflowRunJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/runs/0/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/jobs`

<h3 id="lists-all-jobs-for-a-workflow-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repository|
|run|path|integer|true|runid of the workflow run|
|status|query|string|false|workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|
|sort|query|string|false|sort jobs by attribute. Supported values are "id". Default is "id"|
|order|query|string|false|sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc"|

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs`

<h3 id="list-runs-for-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|workflow_id|path|string|true|id of the workflow, must be the workflow file name (e.g. `build.yml`)|
|event|query|string|false|workflow event name|
|branch|query|string|false|workflow branch|
|status|query|string|false|workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)|
|actor|query|string|false|triggered by user|
|head_sha|query|string|false|triggering sha of the workflow run|
|exclude_pull_requests|query|boolean|false|if true, the `pull_requests` field on each returned run is emptied|
|scoped_workflow_source_repo_id|query|integer(int64)|false|For a scoped workflow, the ID of the source repository providing it; omit or 0 for a repo-level workflow.|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

## List a repository's activity feeds

<a id="opIdrepoListActivityFeeds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/activities/feeds \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/activities/feeds`

<h3 id="list-a-repositorys-activity-feeds-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|

|date|query|string(date)|false|the date of the activities to be found|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits`

<h3 id="get-a-list-of-all-commits-from-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|sha|query|string|false|SHA or branch to start listing commits from (usually 'master')|
|path|query|string|false|filepath of a file/dir|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|Only commits after this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)|
|until|query|string(date-time)|false|Only commits before this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)|
|stat|query|boolean|false|include diff stats for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')|
|verification|query|boolean|false|include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')|
|files|query|boolean|false|include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results (ignored if used with 'path')|
|not|query|string|false|commits that match the given specifier will not be listed.|

## Get a commit's statuses, by branch/tag/commit reference

<a id="opIdrepoListStatusesByRef"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/commits/string/statuses \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/statuses`

<h3 id="get-a-commits-statuses-by-branchtagcommit-reference-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|ref|path|string|true|name of branch/tag/commit|
|sort|query|string|false|type of sort|
|state|query|string|false|type of state|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|oldest|
|sort|recentupdate|
|sort|leastupdate|
|sort|leastindex|
|sort|highestindex|
|state|pending|
|state|success|
|state|error|
|state|failure|
|state|warning|

> Example responses

> 200 Response


<h3 id="get-a-commits-statuses-by-branchtagcommit-reference-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|CommitStatusList|Inline|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

<h3 id="get-a-commits-statuses-by-branchtagcommit-reference-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[CommitStatus](#schemacommitstatus)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Get the merged pull request of the commit

<a id="opIdrepoGetCommitPullRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/commits/string/pull \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pull`

<h3 id="get-the-merged-pull-request-of-the-commit-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|sha|path|string|true|SHA of the commit to get|

## Get commit comparison information

<a id="opIdrepoCompareDiff"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/compare/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{basehead}`

By default returns JSON commit comparison information. The raw diff or patch can be
requested with the `output` query parameter set to `diff` or `patch` respectively.


<h3 id="get-commit-comparison-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|basehead|path|string|true|compare two refs as `base...head` (or `base..head`); refs may be branches, tags, full or short SHAs (including branch names that contain slashes), optionally with a `^` or `~N` revision suffix.|
|output|query|string|false|return the raw comparison as `diff` or `patch` instead of JSON|
|verification|query|boolean|false|include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')|
|files|query|boolean|false|include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|output|diff|
|output|patch|

## Modify multiple files in a repository

<a id="opIdrepoChangeFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/contents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "author": {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "branch": "string",
    "committer": {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "dates": {
      "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    },
    "files": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "from_path": "string",
        "operation": "create",
        "path": "string",
        "sha": "string"
      }
    ],
    "force_push": true,
    "message": "string",
    "new_branch": "string",
    "signoff": true
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "content": "string",
      "from_path": "string",
      "operation": "create",
      "path": "string",
      "sha": "string"
    }
  ],
  "force_push": true,
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

<h3 id="modify-multiple-files-in-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|body|body|[ChangeFilesOptions](#schemachangefilesoptions)|true|none|
|» author|body|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|» branch|body|string|false|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|» committer|body|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|» dates|body|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|» files|body|[[ChangeFileOperation](#schemachangefileoperation)]|true|list of file operations|
|» force_push|body|boolean|false|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|» message|body|string|false|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|» new_branch|body|string|false|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|» signoff|body|boolean|false|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

## The extended &quot;contents&quot; API, to get file metadata and/or content, or list a directory.

<a id="opIdrepoGetContentsExt"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/contents-ext/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents-ext/{filepath}`

It guarantees that only one of the response fields is set if the request succeeds. Users can pass "includes=file_content" or "includes=lfs_metadata" to retrieve more fields. "includes=file_content" only works for single file, if you need to retrieve file contents in batch, use "file-contents" API after listing the directory.

<h3 id="the-extended-contents-api-to-get-file-metadata-andor-content-or-list-a-directory-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|filepath|path|string|true|path of the dir, file, symlink or submodule in the repo. Swagger requires path parameter to be "required", you can leave it empty or pass a single dot (".") to get the root directory.|
|ref|query|string|false|the name of the commit/branch/tag, default to the repository’s default branch.|
|includes|query|string|false|By default this API's response only contains file's metadata. Use comma-separated "includes" options to retrieve more fields. Option "file_content" will try to retrieve the file content, "lfs_metadata" will try to retrieve LFS metadata, "commit_metadata" will try to retrieve commit metadata, and "commit_message" will try to retrieve commit message.|

## Update a file in a repository if SHA is set, or create the file if SHA is not set

<a id="opIdrepoUpdateFile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/contents/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "author": {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "branch": "string",
    "committer": {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "content": "string",
    "dates": {
      "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    },
    "force_push": true,
    "from_path": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "new_branch": "string",
    "sha": "string",
    "signoff": true
  }'
```

`PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{filepath}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },

  "committer": {

  },

  },

  "from_path": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "sha": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-file-in-a-repository-if-sha-is-set-or-create-the-file-if-sha-is-not-set-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|filepath|path|string|true|path of the file to update|
|body|body|[UpdateFileOptions](#schemaupdatefileoptions)|true|none|
|» author|body|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|» branch|body|string|false|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|» committer|body|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|» content|body|string|true|content must be base64 encoded|
|» dates|body|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|» force_push|body|boolean|false|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|» from_path|body|string|false|from_path (optional) is the path of the original file which will be moved/renamed to the path in the URL|
|» message|body|string|false|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|» new_branch|body|string|false|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|» sha|body|string|false|the blob ID (SHA) for the file that already exists to update, or leave it empty to create a new file|
|» signoff|body|boolean|false|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

## Get the metadata and contents of requested files

<a id="opIdrepoGetFileContentsPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/file-contents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "files": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/file-contents`

Uses automatic pagination based on default page size and max response size and returns the maximum allowed number of files. Files which could not be retrieved are null. Files which are too large are being returned with `encoding == null`, `content == null` and `size > 0`, they can be requested separately by using the `download_url`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "files": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-the-metadata-and-contents-of-requested-files-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|ref|query|string|false|The name of the commit/branch/tag. Default to the repository’s default branch.|
|body|body|[GetFilesOptions](#schemagetfilesoptions)|true|none|
|» files|body|[string]|false|Files is the list of file paths to retrieve|

```json
    "url": "http://example.com"
  }
]
```

## Create a hook

<a id="opIdrepoCreateHook"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/hooks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "active": false,
    "authorization_header": "string",
    "branch_filter": "string",
    "config": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "events": [
      "string"
    ],
    "name": "string",
    "type": "dingtalk"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/hooks`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "authorization_header": "string",
  "branch_filter": "string",
  "config": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "events": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "type": "dingtalk"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-hook-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|body|body|[CreateHookOption](#schemacreatehookoption)|false|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Whether the webhook should be active upon creation|
|» authorization_header|body|string|false|Authorization header to include in webhook requests|
|» branch_filter|body|string|false|Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook|
|» config|body|[CreateHookOptionConfig](#schemacreatehookoptionconfig)|true|CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it<br>required are "content_type" and "url" Required|
|» events|body|[string]|false|List of events that will trigger this webhook|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional human-readable name for the webhook|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of the webhook to create|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|dingtalk|
|» type|discord|
|» type|gitea|
|» type|gogs|

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Add a key to a repository

<a id="opIdrepoCreateKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/keys \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "read_only": true,
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/keys`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "read_only": true,
  "title": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-key-to-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|body|body|[CreateKeyOption](#schemacreatekeyoption)|false|none|
|» key|body|string|true|An armored SSH key to add|
|» read_only|body|boolean|false|Describe if the key has only read access or read/write|
|» title|body|string|true|Title of the key to add|

```bash
  -d '{
    "read_only": true,
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

> Code samples

```bash

  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -d '{
```

```json
    ]
```
```bash
  }'
```

## List a repo's pull requests

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`

<h3 id="list-a-repos-pull-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|Name of the repo|
|base_branch|query|string|false|Filter by target base branch of the pull request|
|state|query|string|false|State of pull request|
|sort|query|string|false|Type of sort|
|milestone|query|integer(int64)|false|ID of the milestone|
|labels|query|[integer(int64)]|false|Label IDs|
|poster|query|string|false|Filter by pull request author|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|Page size of results|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|open|
|state|closed|
|state|all|
|sort|oldest|
|sort|recentupdate|
|sort|recentclose|
|sort|leastupdate|
|sort|mostcomment|
|sort|leastcomment|
|sort|priority|
