<h3 id="list-a-repos-pull-requests-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[PullRequest](#schemapullrequest)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Create a pull request

<a id="opIdrepoCreatePullRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "allow_maintainer_edit": true,
    "assignee": "string",
    "assignees": [
      "string"
    ],
    "base": "string",
    "body": "string",
    "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "head": "string",
    "labels": [
      0
    ],
    "milestone": 0,
    "reviewers": [
      "string"
    ],
    "team_reviewers": [
      "string"
    ],
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "allow_maintainer_edit": true,
  "assignee": "string",
  "assignees": [
    "string"
  ],
  "base": "string",
  "body": "string",
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "head": "string",
  "labels": [
    0
  ],
  "milestone": 0,
  "reviewers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "team_reviewers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "title": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-pull-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|body|body|[CreatePullRequestOption](#schemacreatepullrequestoption)|false|none|
|» allow_maintainer_edit|body|boolean|false|Whether maintainers can edit the pull request|
|» assignee|body|string|false|The primary assignee username|
|» assignees|body|[string]|false|The list of assignee usernames|
|» base|body|string|false|The base branch for the pull request|
|» body|body|string|false|The description body of the pull request|
|» due_date|body|string(date-time)|false|none|
|» head|body|string|false|The head branch for the pull request, it could be a branch name on the base repository or<br>a form like `<username>:<branch>` which refers to the user's fork repository's branch.|
|» labels|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The list of label IDs to assign to the pull request|
|» milestone|body|integer(int64)|false|The milestone ID to assign to the pull request|
|» reviewers|body|[string]|false|The list of reviewer usernames|
|» team_reviewers|body|[string]|false|The list of team reviewer names|
|» title|body|string|false|The title of the pull request|

|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|

</aside>

## Resolve a pull request review comment

<a id="opIdrepoResolvePullReviewComment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls/comments/0/resolve \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/comments/{id}/resolve`

<h3 id="resolve-a-pull-request-review-comment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|id|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the review comment|

<h3 id="resolve-a-pull-request-review-comment-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|APIEmpty is an empty response|None|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

<h3 id="list-a-repos-pinned-pull-requests-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|PullRequestList|Inline|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

<h3 id="list-a-repos-pinned-pull-requests-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[PullRequest](#schemapullrequest)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Get a pull request by base and head

<a id="opIdrepoGetPullRequestByBaseHead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{base}/{head}`

<h3 id="get-a-pull-request-by-base-and-head-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|base|path|string|true|base of the pull request to get|
|head|path|string|true|head of the pull request to get|

<h3 id="get-a-pull-request-by-base-and-head-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|PullRequest|[PullRequest](#schemapullrequest)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Get a pull request

<a id="opIdrepoGetPullRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}`

<h3 id="get-a-pull-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the pull request to get|

<h3 id="get-a-pull-request-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|PullRequest|[PullRequest](#schemapullrequest)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Update a pull request. If using deadline only the date will be taken into account, and time of day ignored.

<a id="opIdrepoEditPullRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls/0 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "allow_maintainer_edit": true,
    "assignee": "string",
    "assignees": [
      "string"
    ],
    "base": "string",
    "body": "string",
    "content_version": 0,
    "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "labels": [
      0
    ],
    "milestone": 0,
    "state": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "unset_due_date": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "allow_maintainer_edit": true,
  "assignee": "string",
  "assignees": [
    "string"
  ],
  "base": "string",
  "body": "string",
  "content_version": 0,
  "due_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "labels": [
    0
  ],
  "milestone": 0,
  "state": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "unset_due_date": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-pull-request-if-using-deadline-only-the-date-will-be-taken-into-account-and-time-of-day-ignored-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the pull request to edit|
|body|body|[EditPullRequestOption](#schemaeditpullrequestoption)|false|none|
|» allow_maintainer_edit|body|boolean|false|Whether to allow maintainer edits|
|» assignee|body|string|false|The new primary assignee username|
|» assignees|body|[string]|false|The new list of assignee usernames|
|» base|body|string|false|The new base branch for the pull request|
|» body|body|string|false|The new description body for the pull request|
|» content_version|body|integer(int64)|false|The current version of the pull request content to detect conflicts during editing|
|» due_date|body|string(date-time)|false|Deadline is the updated due date for the pull request, use null or empty string to remove the deadline|
|» labels|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The new list of label IDs for the pull request|
|» milestone|body|integer(int64)|false|The new milestone ID for the pull request|
|» state|body|string|false|The new state for the pull request|
|» title|body|string|false|The new title for the pull request|
|» unset_due_date|body|boolean|false|Whether to remove the current deadline|

<h3 id="update-a-pull-request-if-using-deadline-only-the-date-will-be-taken-into-account-and-time-of-day-ignored-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|PullRequest|[PullRequest](#schemapullrequest)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Get a pull request diff or patch

<a id="opIdrepoDownloadPullDiffOrPatch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/repos/string/string/pulls/0.diff \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}.{diffType}`

<h3 id="get-a-pull-request-diff-or-patch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|path|string|true|owner of the repo|
|repo|path|string|true|name of the repo|
|index|path|integer(int64)|true|index of the pull request to get|
|diffType|path|string|true|whether the output is diff or patch|
|binary|query|boolean|false|whether to include binary file changes. if true, the diff is applicable with `git apply`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|diffType|diff|
|diffType|patch|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"string"
```

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "avatar": true,
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "git_content": true,
    "git_hooks": true,
    "labels": true,
    "name": "string",
    "owner": "string",
    "private": true,
    "protected_branch": true,
    "topics": true,
    "webhooks": true
  }'
```

`POST /repos/{template_owner}/{template_repo}/generate`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "avatar": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "git_content": true,
  "git_hooks": true,
  "labels": true,
  "name": "string",
  "owner": "string",
  "private": true,
  "protected_branch": true,
  "topics": true,
  "webhooks": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-repository-using-a-template-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|template_owner|path|string|true|owner of the template repository|
|template_repo|path|string|true|name of the template repository|
|body|body|[GenerateRepoOption](#schemageneraterepooption)|false|none|
|» avatar|body|boolean|false|include avatar of the template repo|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|Default branch of the new repository|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the repository to create|
|» git_content|body|boolean|false|include git content of default branch in template repo|
|» git_hooks|body|boolean|false|include git hooks in template repo|
|» labels|body|boolean|false|include labels in template repo|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» owner|body|string|true|the organization's name or individual user's name who will own the new repository|
|» private|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is private|
|» protected_branch|body|boolean|false|include protected branches in template repo|
|» topics|body|boolean|false|include topics in template repo|
|» webhooks|body|boolean|false|include webhooks in template repo|

|order|query|string|false|sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc"|

## Add an issue to a project column

## Create a repository

<a id="opIdcreateCurrentUserRepo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/user/repos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_init": true,
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gitignores": "string",
    "issue_labels": "string",
    "license": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "object_format_name": {},
    "private": true,
    "readme": "string",
    "template": true,
    "trust_model": "default"
  }'
```

`POST /user/repos`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_init": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gitignores": "string",
  "issue_labels": "string",
  "license": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "object_format_name": {},
  "private": true,
  "readme": "string",
  "template": true,
  "trust_model": "default"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateRepoOption](#schemacreaterepooption)|false|none|
|» auto_init|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository should be auto-initialized?|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|DefaultBranch of the repository (used when initializes and in template)|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the repository to create|
|» gitignores|body|string|false|Gitignores to use|
|» issue_labels|body|string|false|Label-Set to use|
|» license|body|string|false|License to use|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the repository to create|
|» object_format_name|body|object|false|ObjectFormatName of the underlying git repository, empty string for default (sha1)|
|» private|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is private|
|» readme|body|string|false|Readme of the repository to create|
|» template|body|boolean|false|Whether the repository is template|
|» trust_model|body|string|false|TrustModel of the repository|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» trust_model|default|
|» trust_model|collaborator|
|» trust_model|committer|
|» trust_model|collaboratorcommitter|

## Update user settings

<a id="opIdupdateUserSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/user/settings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "diff_view_style": "string",
    "full_name": "string",
    "hide_activity": true,
    "hide_email": true,
    "language": "string",
    "location": "string",
    "theme": "string",
    "website": "string"
  }'
```

## List the authenticated user's access tokens

<a id="opIduserGetTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/users/string/tokens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /users/{username}/tokens`

<h3 id="list-the-authenticated-users-access-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|username of to user whose access tokens are to be listed|
|page|query|integer|false|page number of results to return (1-based)|
|limit|query|integer|false|page size of results|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "id": 0,
    "last_used_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "name": "string",
    "scopes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "sha1": "string",
    "token_last_eight": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-the-authenticated-users-access-tokens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|AccessTokenList represents a list of API access token.|Inline|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

<h3 id="list-the-authenticated-users-access-tokens-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[AccessToken](#schemaaccesstoken)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## Create an access token

<a id="opIduserCreateToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/users/string/tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "scopes": [
      "all",
      "read:activitypub",
      "write:commitstatus",
      "read:issue",
      "write:misc",
      "read:notification",
      "read:organization",
      "read:package",
      "read:repository",
      "read:user"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /users/{username}/tokens`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "scopes": [
    "all",
    "read:activitypub",
    "write:commitstatus",
    "read:issue",
    "write:misc",
    "read:notification",
    "read:organization",
    "read:package",
    "read:repository",
    "read:user"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|username of the user whose token is to be created|
|body|body|[CreateAccessTokenOption](#schemacreateaccesstokenoption)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» scopes|body|[string]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "id": 0,
  "last_used_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "name": "string",
  "scopes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sha1": "string",
  "token_last_eight": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-access-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|AccessToken represents an API access token.|[AccessToken](#schemaaccesstoken)|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

## delete an access token

<a id="opIduserDeleteAccessToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitea.com/api/v1/users/string/tokens/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /users/{username}/tokens/{token}`

<h3 id="delete-an-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|username of the user whose token is to be deleted|
|token|path|string|true|token to be deleted, identified by ID and if not available by name|

<h3 id="delete-an-access-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|APIEmpty is an empty response|None|
|default|Default|APIError is error format response|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|default|message|string||none|
|default|url|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth, Token, AccessToken, AuthorizationHeaderToken, SudoParam, SudoHeader, TOTPHeader
</aside>

<h2 id="tocS_AccessToken">AccessToken</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="schema_AccessToken"></a>
<a id="tocSaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="tocsaccesstoken"></a>

```json
{
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "id": 0,
  "last_used_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "name": "string",
  "scopes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sha1": "string",
  "token_last_eight": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The timestamp when the token was created|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|The unique identifier of the access token|
|last_used_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The timestamp when the token was last used|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the access token|
|scopes|[string]|false|none|The scopes granted to this access token|
|sha1|string|false|none|The SHA1 hash of the access token|
|token_last_eight|string|false|none|The last eight characters of the token|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actor|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|artifacts_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|cancel_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|completed_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|conclusion|string|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|display_title|string|false|none|none|
|event|string|false|none|none|
|head_branch|string|false|none|none|
|head_repository|[Repository](#schemarepository)|false|none|Repository represents a repository|
|head_sha|string|false|none|none|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|jobs_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|logs_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|path|string|false|none|none|
|previous_attempt_url|string(uri)|false|none|PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt-1}".<br>It is set only when the current attempt is > 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null.|
|pull_requests|[[PullRequestMinimal](#schemapullrequestminimal)]|false|none|none|
|repository|[Repository](#schemarepository)|false|none|Repository represents a repository|
|repository_id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|rerun_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|run_attempt|integer(int64)|false|none|RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced.<br>A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed<br>and indicates no corresponding /attempts/{n} resource is available.|
|run_number|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|started_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|status|string|false|none|none|
|trigger_actor|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|none|

|id|integer(int64)|false|none|The unique identifier of the activity|
|is_private|boolean|false|none|Whether this activity is from a private repository|

|repo_id|integer(int64)|false|none|The ID of the repository associated with the activity|
|user_id|integer(int64)|false|none|The ID of the user who receives/sees this activity|

<a id="schemaapplydiffpatchfileoptions"></a>

<a id="tocsapplydiffpatchfileoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "content": "string",
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "force_push": true,
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

ApplyDiffPatchFileOptions options for applying a diff patch
Note: `author` and `committer` are optional (if only one is given, it will be used for the other, otherwise the authenticated user will be used)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|branch|string|false|none|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|committer|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|content|string|true|none|none|
|dates|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|none|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|force_push|boolean|false|none|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|message|string|false|none|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|new_branch|string|false|none|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|signoff|boolean|false|none|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

<h2 id="tocS_ChangeFileOperation">ChangeFileOperation</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemachangefileoperation"></a>
<a id="schema_ChangeFileOperation"></a>
<a id="tocSchangefileoperation"></a>
<a id="tocschangefileoperation"></a>

```json
{
  "content": "string",
  "from_path": "string",
  "operation": "create",
  "path": "string",
  "sha": "string"
}
```

ChangeFileOperation for creating, updating or deleting a file

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|content|string|false|none|new or updated file content, it must be base64 encoded|
|from_path|string|false|none|old path of the file to move|
|operation|string|true|none|indicates what to do with the file: "create" for creating a new file, "update" for updating an existing file,<br>"upload" for creating or updating a file, "rename" for renaming a file, and "delete" for deleting an existing file.|
|path|string|true|none|path to the existing or new file|
|sha|string|false|none|the blob ID (SHA) for the file that already exists, required for changing existing files|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|operation|create|
|operation|update|
|operation|upload|
|operation|rename|
|operation|delete|

<h2 id="tocS_ChangeFilesOptions">ChangeFilesOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemachangefilesoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_ChangeFilesOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSchangefilesoptions"></a>
<a id="tocschangefilesoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "content": "string",
      "from_path": "string",
      "operation": "create",
      "path": "string",
      "sha": "string"
    }
  ],
  "force_push": true,
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

ChangeFilesOptions options for creating, updating or deleting multiple files
Note: `author` and `committer` are optional (if only one is given, it will be used for the other, otherwise the authenticated user will be used)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|branch|string|false|none|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|committer|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|dates|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|none|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|files|[[ChangeFileOperation](#schemachangefileoperation)]|true|none|list of file operations|
|force_push|boolean|false|none|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|message|string|false|none|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|new_branch|string|false|none|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|signoff|boolean|false|none|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

ChangedFile store information about files affected by the pull request

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additions|integer(int64)|false|none|The number of lines added to the file|
|changes|integer(int64)|false|none|The total number of changes to the file|
|contents_url|string(uri)|false|none|The API URL to get the file contents|
|deletions|integer(int64)|false|none|The number of lines deleted from the file|
|filename|string|false|none|The name of the changed file|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|The HTML URL to view the file changes|
|previous_filename|string|false|none|The previous filename if the file was renamed|
|raw_url|string(uri)|false|none|The raw URL to download the file|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the file change (added, modified, deleted, etc.)|

```json
  "last_author_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "last_commit_message": "string",
  "last_commit_sha": "string",
  "last_committer_date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "lfs_oid": "string",
  "lfs_size": 0,
  "mode": "string",
  "name": "string",
```

ContentsResponse contains information about a repo's entry's (dir, file, symlink, submodule) metadata and content

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[FileLinksResponse](#schemafilelinksresponse)|false|none|FileLinksResponse contains the links for a repo's file|
|content|string|false|none|`content` is populated when `type` is `file`, otherwise null|
|download_url|string(uri)|false|none|DownloadURL is the direct download URL for this file|
|encoding|string|false|none|`encoding` is populated when `type` is `file`, otherwise null|
|git_url|string(uri)|false|none|GitURL is the Git API URL for this blob or tree|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|HTMLURL is the web URL for this file or directory|
|last_author_date|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|last_commit_message|string|false|none|LastCommitMessage is the message of the last commit that affected this file|
|last_commit_sha|string|false|none|LastCommitSHA is the SHA of the last commit that affected this file|
|last_committer_date|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|lfs_oid|string|false|none|LfsOid is the Git LFS object ID if this file is stored in LFS|
|lfs_size|integer(int64)|false|none|LfsSize is the file size if this file is stored in LFS|
|mode|string|false|none|`mode` is the Git file mode as an octal string, e.g. `100644` (regular), `100755` (executable), `120000` (symlink), `160000` (submodule)|
|name|string|false|none|Name is the file or directory name|
|path|string|false|none|Path is the full path to the file or directory|
|sha|string|false|none|SHA is the Git blob or tree SHA|
|size|integer(int64)|false|none|Size is the file size in bytes|
|submodule_git_url|string(uri)|false|none|`submodule_git_url` is populated when `type` is `submodule`, otherwise null|
|target|string|false|none|`target` is populated when `type` is `symlink`, otherwise null|
|type|string|false|none|`type` will be `file`, `dir`, `symlink`, or `submodule`|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|URL is the API URL for this file or directory|

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "content": "string",
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },

  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

CreateFileOptions options for creating a file
Note: `author` and `committer` are optional (if only one is given, it will be used for the other, otherwise the authenticated user will be used)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|branch|string|false|none|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|committer|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|content|string|true|none|content must be base64 encoded|
|dates|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|none|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|force_push|boolean|false|none|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|message|string|false|none|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|new_branch|string|false|none|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|signoff|boolean|false|none|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

<h2 id="tocS_DeleteFileOptions">DeleteFileOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadeletefileoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_DeleteFileOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSdeletefileoptions"></a>
<a id="tocsdeletefileoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "force_push": true,
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "sha": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

DeleteFileOptions options for deleting a file
Note: `author` and `committer` are optional (if only one is given, it will be used for the other, otherwise the authenticated user will be used)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|branch|string|false|none|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|committer|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|dates|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|none|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|force_push|boolean|false|none|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|message|string|false|none|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|new_branch|string|false|none|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|sha|string|true|none|the blob ID (SHA) for the file to delete|
|signoff|boolean|false|none|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|

```json
    "enable_issue_dependencies": true,
    "enable_time_tracker": true
  },
```

```json
  "mirror_token": "string",

  "projects_mode": "string",
  "squash_merge_commit_message": "string",
  "template": true,
  "website": "string"

```

EditRepoOption options when editing a repository's properties

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_fast_forward_only_merge|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow fast-forward-only merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent fast-forward-only merging.|
|allow_manual_merge|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow mark pr as merged manually, or `false` to prevent it.|
|allow_merge_commits|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow merging pull requests with a merge commit, or `false` to prevent merging pull requests with merge commits.|
|allow_merge_update|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by merge, or `false` to prevent it.|
|allow_rebase|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow rebase-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent rebase-merging.|
|allow_rebase_explicit|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow rebase with explicit merge commits (--no-ff), or `false` to prevent rebase with explicit merge commits.|
|allow_rebase_update|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by rebase, or `false` to prevent it.|
|allow_squash_merge|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow squash-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent squash-merging.|
|archived|boolean|false|none|set to `true` to archive this repository.|
|autodetect_manual_merge|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable AutodetectManualMerge, or `false` to prevent it. Note: In some special cases, misjudgments can occur.|
|default_allow_maintainer_edit|boolean|false|none|set to `true` to allow edits from maintainers by default|
|default_branch|string|false|none|sets the default branch for this repository.|
|default_delete_branch_after_merge|boolean|false|none|set to `true` to delete pr branch after merge by default|
|default_merge_style|string|false|none|set to a merge style to be used by this repository: "merge", "rebase", "rebase-merge", "squash", or "fast-forward-only".|
|default_update_style|string|false|none|set to an update style to be used by this repository: "merge" or "rebase".|
|description|string|false|none|a short description of the repository.|
|enable_prune|boolean|false|none|enable prune - remove obsolete remote-tracking references when mirroring|
|external_tracker|[ExternalTracker](#schemaexternaltracker)|false|none|ExternalTracker represents settings for external tracker|
|external_wiki|[ExternalWiki](#schemaexternalwiki)|false|none|ExternalWiki represents setting for external wiki|
|has_actions|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable actions unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|has_code|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable code for this repository or `false` to disable it.|
|has_issues|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable issues for this repository or `false` to disable them.|
|has_packages|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable packages unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|has_projects|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable project unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|has_pull_requests|boolean|false|none|either `true` to allow pull requests, or `false` to prevent pull request.|
|has_releases|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable releases unit, or `false` to disable them.|
|has_wiki|boolean|false|none|either `true` to enable the wiki for this repository or `false` to disable it.|
|ignore_whitespace_conflicts|boolean|false|none|either `true` to ignore whitespace for conflicts, or `false` to not ignore whitespace.|
|internal_tracker|[InternalTracker](#schemainternaltracker)|false|none|InternalTracker represents settings for internal tracker|
|mirror_interval|string|false|none|set to a string like `8h30m0s` to set the mirror interval time|
|mirror_password|string|false|none|authentication password for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|mirror_token|string|false|none|authentication token for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|mirror_username|string|false|none|authentication username for the remote repository (mirrors)|
|name|string|false|none|name of the repository|
|private|boolean|false|none|either `true` to make the repository private or `false` to make it public.<br>Note: you will get a 422 error if the organization restricts changing repository visibility to organization<br>owners and a non-owner tries to change the value of private.|
|projects_mode|string|false|none|`repo` to only allow repo-level projects, `owner` to only allow owner projects, `all` to allow both.|
|squash_merge_commit_message|string|false|none|set the default squash merge commit message body: "PR_BODY", "COMMIT_MESSAGES", or "BLANK".|
|template|boolean|false|none|either `true` to make this repository a template or `false` to make it a normal repository|
|website|string|false|none|a URL with more information about the repository.|

Package represents a package

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the package was created|
|creator|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|The HTML URL to view the package|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|The unique identifier of the package|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the package|
|owner|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|repository|[Repository](#schemarepository)|false|none|Repository represents a repository|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the package (e.g., npm, maven, docker)|
|version|string|false|none|The version of the package|

|size|integer(int64)|false|none|The size of the package file in bytes|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|creator|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|creator_id|integer(int64)|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated: use Creator instead|
|description|string|false|none|none|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|is_closed|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated: use State instead|
|num_closed_issues|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|num_issues|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|num_open_issues|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|owner_id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|

|read_only|boolean|false|none|ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access|
|title|string|false|none|Title is the human-readable name for the key|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|URL is the API URL for this key|
|user|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|

TimelineComment represents a timeline comment (comment of any type) on a commit or issue

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assignee|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|assignee_team|[Team](#schemateam)|false|none|Team represents a team in an organization|
|body|string|false|none|Body contains the timeline event content|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|dependent_issue|[Issue](#schemaissue)|false|none|Issue represents an issue in a repository|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|HTMLURL is the web URL for viewing the comment|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|ID is the unique identifier for the timeline comment|
|issue_url|string(uri)|false|none|IssueURL is the API URL for the issue|
|label|[Label](#schemalabel)|false|none|Label a label to an issue or a pr|
|milestone|[Milestone](#schemamilestone)|false|none|Milestone is a collection of issues on one repository|
|new_ref|string|false|none|none|
|new_title|string|false|none|none|
|old_milestone|[Milestone](#schemamilestone)|false|none|Milestone is a collection of issues on one repository|
|old_project_id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|old_ref|string|false|none|none|
|old_title|string|false|none|none|
|project_id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|pull_request_url|string(uri)|false|none|PRURL is the API URL for the pull request (if applicable)|
|ref_action|string|false|none|none|
|ref_comment|[Comment](#schemacomment)|false|none|Comment represents a comment on a commit or issue|
|ref_commit_sha|string|false|none|commit SHA where issue/PR was referenced|
|ref_issue|[Issue](#schemaissue)|false|none|Issue represents an issue in a repository|
|removed_assignee|boolean|false|none|whether the assignees were removed or added|
|resolve_doer|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|
|review_id|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|tracked_time|[TrackedTime](#schematrackedtime)|false|none|TrackedTime worked time for an issue / pr|
|type|string|false|none|Type indicates the type of timeline event|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|user|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|User represents a user|

<h2 id="tocS_UpdateFileOptions">UpdateFileOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaupdatefileoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_UpdateFileOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSupdatefileoptions"></a>
<a id="tocsupdatefileoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "author": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "branch": "string",
  "committer": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "content": "string",
  "dates": {
    "author": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "committer": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "force_push": true,
  "from_path": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "new_branch": "string",
  "sha": "string",
  "signoff": true
}
```

UpdateFileOptions options for updating or creating a file
Note: `author` and `committer` are optional (if only one is given, it will be used for the other, otherwise the authenticated user will be used)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|branch|string|false|none|branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used|
|committer|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer|
|content|string|true|none|content must be base64 encoded|
|dates|[CommitDateOptions](#schemacommitdateoptions)|false|none|CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE|
|force_push|boolean|false|none|force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists|
|from_path|string|false|none|from_path (optional) is the path of the original file which will be moved/renamed to the path in the URL|
|message|string|false|none|message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used|
|new_branch|string|false|none|new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch|
|sha|string|false|none|the blob ID (SHA) for the file that already exists to update, or leave it empty to create a new file|
|signoff|boolean|false|none|Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message.|
